title: Kagamine Len — Ideal Protagonist〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This ended up being a nice break.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sure thing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we should head back!
We have that meeting about the arts festival with the others!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, good luck☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, we'll be going.
Please tell KAITO and the others we said hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, an arts festival!
They both sounded really excited☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not only that, Tsukasa's the lead with Rui as the director... I bet their play's gonna be great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think Nene's class is gonna do? Also a play? Oh, what if they sang as a chorus or something...?!
You all seem to be having a fun conversation. What's going on here?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! Oh, plus MEIKO and Luka☆ You just missed Tsukasa and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Their school's holding an arts festival, and their class is gonna put on a play for it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds enjoyable.
Have they already decided on one?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, they said...
They're paying homage to “The Phantom Of The Opera”!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To “The Phantom Of The Opera”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently, their story involves rumors of a mysterious phantom hiding underground below this one popular theatre...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: One day, the protagonist, a young actor, decides to go investigate and find out the truth!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, it's the same as the original so far.
And then?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He finds himself in a grassy field that he doesn't recognize at all...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? A grassy field...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! He was sent to another world!
That's where his adventure begins, which is gonna be filled with both sadness and joy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's quite the twist.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like a wonderful surprise.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still... Ending up in a completely unfamiliar place...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That sounds like Tsukasa and the others when we first met them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the first time they came to SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The look on Tsukasa's face when he saw me and the plushies was so priceless!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wasn't it? So, I think they have a good understanding of what it's actually like to be sent to another world.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...! Then, Tsukasa's probably gonna do an amazing job as the lead!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also wonder what Rui will decide to do as the director.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The inclusion of another world points towards fantasy...
Rui should have plenty of opportunities to wow the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I kinda feel like doing a show now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we do one together?
Something about being sent to another world!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh☆ I wanna do that too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's start coming up with a story!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like fun!
Where would you like to be sent, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I were to choose... I'd wanna be sent to a really big school!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A big school?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! A school where us, the plushies, Tsukasa, the others and all sorts of people attend as students!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'd wake up at this school to discover that we're all classmates!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Us as classmates...?
Hehe. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Exactly!
We'd study together, hang out around campus after school...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And there's the school festival!
We could do a show with the plushies!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But something bad would happen while preparing for it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something bad?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A group of bad guy plushies suddenly appears! They start messing up the school and attacking our plushie friends!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no!
But we would've been having so much fun preparing for our show☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why we're gonna stand up against them as a class and drive them out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's really cool!
We'd be the ones saving our friends and the school festival♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm getting all excited just talking about this show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice idea, Len!
It definitely sounds like a fun show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Then, let's keep working on it together!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
